description: Phase 2 placeholder — error-handling workflow for the product-video pipeline. Attached as the error workflow of product-video-main in Phase 3.
name: product-video-errors

nodes.notes: Receives the failed execution context: workflow, node, error message, and jobId from the original payload.

Classify as retryable (429, 5xx, timeouts, provider overload) vs permanent (validation, REJECTED compliance, auth). Retryable → bounded retry with exponential backoff + jitter; permanent → mark FAILED.
Persists the failure: JobEvent row, failed JobStage state, RetryRecord when retrying. Frontend shows clear failure messages + retry controls.
Optional notification hook (Phase 3+). Never loops back into the main workflow.

safety: No infinite loops: error workflow never triggers itself.
Idempotent failure reporting via jobId + stageKey.
Secrets only in n8n credential store / env, never in node parameters.
